defaultDescription: Online SVG code editor with live preview, schema-aware autocomplete, hover docs, color picker, and cloud storage. AI chat and image generation available as pro features.

/gallery.title: SVG Gallery
/gallery.description: Browse public SVG drawings shared by the community. Every drawing is CC0 1.0 — open one to view its code and AI chat, or start your own copy.

/features.title: Features
/features.description: Live preview, schema-aware autocomplete from the W3C SVG spec, hover documentation, click-to-select, AI chat editing, image generation with vectorization, and icon search.

/pricing.title: Pricing
/pricing.description: Credit-based pricing for the AI assistant. Free monthly credits, pay-as-you-go top-ups, and a pro tier for the larger models.
